items.headline: Gaza: saans ki bimari badhi, WHO chetavni
items.detail: WHO ne kaha Gaza me saans ki bimari ke cases pichhle saal se 33,000 zyada hain; baarish se hazaaron tent doob gaye aur lagbhag 10 lakh visthapit baadh ke khatre wale ilaakon me rehte hain.
items.exam_angle: Gaza me manavtavadi sankat, WHO aur svasthya — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Dublin: netaon ke dinner ke paas bomb mila
items.detail: Dublin me Merrion Square ki imarat me crude lekin kaam karne wala bomb mila aur sena ne use nishkriya kiya; ek din pehle paas ke National Gallery me Macron samet netaon ne dinner kiya tha.
items.exam_angle: Europe me suraksha aur European Political Community shikhar sammelan — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Iran ke paas ab bhi 2,500 missile
items.detail: US khufiya anuman ke mutabik Iran ke paas 1,500 se 2,500 missile bache hain; hamlo ke baad bhi Tehran ne stockpile dobara banaya — 'tabah' hone ke daave ke ulta.
items.exam_angle: Iran-America tanav aur missile shakti — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Canary Islands: ek din me 1,500 pravasi
items.detail: Shaniwaar ko Spain ke Canary Islands me lagbhag 1,500 pravasi pahunche — 2020 ke baad ek din me sabse zyada; zyadaatar Senegal, Gambia aur Guinea se aaye.
items.exam_angle: Europe me pravasan aur Atlantic route — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Bahrain ne UN se Iran par karvai mangi
items.detail: Bahrain ne UN Security Council se Iran ke hamlo ki ninda aur sakht karvai ki maang ki; G7 ne bhi hamlo ki ninda ki, jabki Iran ne jawab jaari rakhne ki baat kahi.
items.exam_angle: West Asia me tanav aur UN Security Council — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Phnom Penh: Francophone shikhar, Congo-Rwanda takraar
items.detail: 20th Francophone shikhar sammelan Phnom Penh me shuru hua; somvar ko naye mahasachiv ka chunav hoga, lekin DR Congo ne Rwanda ki Louise Mushikiwabo ke teesre karyakal par sangathan chhodne ki dhamki di hai.
items.exam_angle: Francophonie, Africa aur antarrashtriya sangathan — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Pope Leo: Inca gaon khali, palayan par chinta
items.detail: Pope Leo XIV ne Peru ke Santa Cruz de Succhabamba me kaha ki Inca kshetra ke gaon khali ho rahe hain aur log behtar bhavishya ke liye palayan ko majboor hain; Cajamarca me 40% se zyada log gareebi me rehte hain.
items.exam_angle: Peru, Inca sabhyata aur palayan — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: America ka measles-mukt darja 26 saal baad khatm
items.detail: PAHO panel ne faisla kiya ki America me measles ka ek hi strain 12 mahine se zyada se lagatar phail raha hai; CDC ke anusaar 2026 me 12 November tak 5,182 cases mile, 1991 ke baad sabse zyada — aadhikarik ghoshna abhi baaki hai.
items.exam_angle: Svasthya, teekakaran aur antarrashtriya sangathan — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Tesla Cybercab bikne laga, $29,990 + $299/mahina
items.detail: Tesla ne chuninda grahakon ko bina steering wali Cybercab ka order khola — keemat $29,990, chalane ke liye $299 mahina subscription zaroori, December me Austin se delivery ka anuman.
items.exam_angle: Driverless gaadi, AI aur niyam — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Zelensky: Donbas chhodo to NATO sadasyata
items.detail: Zelensky ne kaha America ke vartakaron ne Abu Dhabi vartao me prastav diya ki Ukraine Donbas chhod de to NATO sadasyata mil sakti hai; unhone kshetra chhodne se inkar kiya, lekin suraksha package mile to janmat sangrah ki baat kahi.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine yuddh aur NATO vistar — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Korea: topper ne AI se nakal mani
items.detail: South Korea me tax accountant exam ke topper Han Won-seok ne mana ki usne chhote camera se sawal photo karke AI se jawab liye; 400 me se 397.5 ank laaye the, Seoul police ne jaanch shuru ki.
items.exam_angle: Pariksha me AI ka durupyog aur pariksha suraksha — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Jordan: church hamle ke teen ko phansi
items.detail: Jordan ki State Security Court ne Ravivaar ko teen logon ko phansi ki saza sunai; 23 October ko Karak ke Greek Orthodox church me janaze ke dauraan hamle me 9 log mare gaye the — faisle par Court of Cassation me appeal ho sakti hai.
items.exam_angle: Jordan me aatankwad par mukadma aur mrityudand — West Asia me suraksha.

items.headline: Gaza aspatal hamle par 18 deshon ki ninda
items.detail: Saudi samet 18 Arab aur Islamic deshon ke videsh mantriyon ne Shaniwaar ko Khan Younis ke Nasser aspatal par Guruvaar ke Israeli hamle ki ninda ki; hamle me ek surgeon aur ek kishore samet 6 log mare gaye the, Israel ka kehna hai usne Hamas commander ko nishana banaya tha.
items.exam_angle: Antarrashtriya manavtavadi kanoon aur chikitsa suvidhaon ki suraksha — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Alaska: 1998 ke baad pehle Democrat governor
items.detail: Democrat Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins Alaska ke governor chune gaye — 1998 ke baad pehle Democrat; 37 saal ke ve rajya ke sabse yuva governor honge aur 7 December ko shapath lenge.
items.exam_angle: America me midterm chunav aur rajya sarkaron me badlav — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: America: router kharabi se udaan sankat, 6,400 radd
items.detail: FAA ne kaha contractor L3Harris ke naye router ki gadbadi se 17 control centres prabhavit hue; Shanivaar ko 6,400 se zyada flights radd hui aur Ravivaar raat tak schedule normal hone ki ummeed hai.
items.exam_angle: Critical infrastructure ki kamzori — UPSC me technology aur suraksha par sawal.

items.headline: Saudi: do ko phansi, nabalig wala aarop
items.detail: Saudi ne Eastern Province me do logon ko 'aatankwad' ke aarop me phansi di; rights group Reprieve ka kehna hai ek vyakti aarop ke samay 14 saal ka tha.
items.exam_angle: Manavadhikar aur mrityudand — antarrashtriya sangathanon ki bhoomika.

items.headline: Microsoft 365 phir chalu, outage khatm
items.detail: Microsoft ne kaha Outlook, Teams aur Copilot 24 ghante se zyada ke global outage ke baad poori tarah bahaal ho gaye; wajah network upgrade ki kharabi thi, cyberattack nahi.
items.exam_angle: Digital infrastructure aur cyber suraksha — bade tech outage ka asar.

items.headline: Shenzhen me APEC CEO Summit, 12 neta aayenge
items.detail: CCPIT ne aaj elaan kiya ki 17-18 November ko Shenzhen me hone wale APEC CEO Summit me Xi Jinping samet 12 arthvyavasthaon ke neta bhashan denge ya panel charcha me hissa lenge; 115 Fortune Global 500 companiyon ke pratinidhi bhi aayenge.
items.exam_angle: APEC aur Asia-Pacific me vyapar sahyog — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Bahrain: Iran ka US base par drone hamla
items.detail: Bahrain me subah dhamake aur siren sunai diye; Iran ke Revolutionary Guards ne daava kiya ki unhone Riffa base par US radar ko chhah drones se nishana banaya — Bahrain ne kaha uski hawai suraksha ne kai hamle roke, abhi koi nuksan ki pushti nahi.
items.exam_angle: West Asia me tanav aur Gulf me US sainya upasthiti — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Manila me 49th ASEAN shikhar sammelan shuru
items.detail: Philippines ke Rashtrapati Marcos ne Manila me 49th ASEAN Summit ka udghatan kiya — vyapar, urja sankat, Myanmar aur South China Sea par charcha; Trump 17 November ko pahunchenge, Quad netaon se alag baithak bhi hogi.
items.exam_angle: ASEAN, Bharat-ASEAN sambandh aur Quad — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Damascus: car bomb me pita-beti mare gaye
items.detail: Damascus ke Jaramana ilaake me shanivaar shaam car bomb phata — ek aadmi aur uski beti mare gaye, ek mahila ghayal; suraksha balon ne jaanch shuru ki, kisi ne zimmedari nahi li.
items.exam_angle: Syria me suraksha sthiti aur West Asia — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: WHO: type 1 diabetes par pehli guidelines
items.detail: WHO ne 14 November ko World Diabetes Day par vayaskon me type 1 diabetes ke liye pehli guidelines jaari ki — roz kai baar insulin injection aur sasti insulin tak pahunch par zor; duniya bhar me 95 lakh log isse peedit hain.
items.exam_angle: WHO, swasthya aur Bharat me diabetes bojh — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: NATO: 2027 me Albania shikhar sammelan nahi
items.detail: NATO ne 2027 me Albania me netaon ka shikhar sammelan na karne ka faisla kiya, mantri-stariya baithaken bhi kam hongi; mahasachiv Rutte ne kaha shikhar sammelan tab hoga jab zaroorat hogi, 2028 me Tirana mezban ho sakta hai.
items.exam_angle: NATO aur Europe ki suraksha vyavastha — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Philippines-Australia raksha samjhauta, 1995 deal update
items.detail: Manila me Philippines aur Australia ne Defence Cooperation Arrangement par hastakshar kiye — 1995 ke samjhaute ka update, sanyukt sainya abhyas aur aapda madad me tezi aayegi; PM Albanese ne samjhaute ko dekha.
items.exam_angle: Indo-Pacific me raksha sahyog aur ASEAN — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.
